motion.$description: Easing curves and durations. Decided so far: the rolling digits of the tools' results and the header fold. Every movement is dropped for readers who ask for reduced motion.

duration.$description: Rolling digits: each digit turns on its own wheel to the new figure, then the cell holds plain text again (2026-11-10)

easing.$description: A spring's settle: quick out of the old digit, a slight run past the new one, back

duration.$description: The header folding its rows of sections on scroll, and the tools' tabs rising with it
